'''Pastron''' was an individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a crew member of the [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Poln Major]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> during a [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]] over Poln Major between Imperial forces and<ref name="Choices" /> [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Eastern Fleet]], Pastron was [[Commanding officer/Legends|ordered]] by the Golan's commander, [[Commandant/Legends|Commandant]] [[Barcelle]], to activate the station's [[torpedo launcher]]s so that the Golan's [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]] could be fired at Esva's [[Whisperlike fighter]]s. The battle ended with the destruction of the Esva's Eastern Fleet and his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], along with the warlord's retreat.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pastron was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
